title: AGB Ultimate Gaming Power Plan
name: agb-power-plan
description: Custom power plan disabling Core Parking, allowing full 100% Turbo/Precision Boost with 5% idle scaling, and disabling PCIe link power management for maximum gaming FPS stability.
deepDescription: Applies an optimized power scheme: disables CPU Core Parking (0cc5b647-c1df-4596-9299-d7a6a057d115 = 100%), sets minimum/maximum CPU frequency state to 100%, and disables PCI Express Link State Power Management to eliminate micro-stutters and improve 1% low FPS.
